items.html: And the Assembly of Israel (Knesset Yisrael) is the inner body, and Malchut is the external body. And the coupling of the two inner bodies is called "kisses, spirit to spirit." Understand this. And so it is in Aba and Ima: the coupling of the inner aspects is called kisses. And the inner of Aba is called Mazla, the name AB; and the inner of ZA is the name MaH, the irrigation of the tree. And relative to the external, the inner is called "kisses, spirit to spirit," for the name MaH is spirit, as above.
